product_one_liner.value: Sprinto automates security compliance, audit readiness, vendor oversight, and risk management for fast-scaling SaaS businesses.
product_one_liner.notes: Sprinto describes an autonomous GRC platform for fast-scaling SaaS businesses that combines audits, vendor oversight, and risk management: https://sprinto.com/industries.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists plans, including Growth. Contact-sales pricing still qualifies under the question's rule: https://sprinto.com/pricing.

employee_band.notes: Sprinto's public LinkedIn company profile explicitly lists 201–500 employees. The published company-size band is used rather than conflicting point estimates: https://linkedin.com/company/31215334.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Both explicit headquarters fields identify San Francisco; this takes precedence over a conflicting description placing the company in Bangalore. Sources: https://craft.co/sprinto/locations and https://linkedin.com/company/31215334. | hq_country: Craft explicitly identifies the headquarters as San Francisco, United States, consistent with Sprinto's LinkedIn headquarters field. This is more specific than the conflicting Bangalore location description. Sources: https://craft.co/sprinto/locations and https://linkedin.com/company/31215334.

founded_year.notes: Sprinto's own job posting explicitly states that it was founded in 2020: https://jobs.lever.co/Sprinto/a5f26631-6667-4de5-b5d6-944959deeabf.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents GRC guidance, comparisons, compliance content, and product material; it did not establish two engineer-authored posts about how Sprinto itself is built. Under the requested definition, this is false: https://sprinto.com/blog/.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal lists several documentation articles, including Quick start, API structure, and Pagination: https://developer.sprinto.com/docs.

launched_6mo.notes: The July–August 2026 release announcement reports Sprinto MCP availability through Claude and ChatGPT and a rebuilt AI retrieval and answer-matching pipeline. leadership_change_12mo.notes: Shourya Saha's profile records a Sprinto start date of June 1, 2026 and identifies him as VP-CX; Sprinto's team page confirms his VP–Customer Experience title. This falls within the 12 months before November 9, 2026. Sources: https://linkedin.com/in/shourya-saha and https://sprinto.com/about-us.
